about.text: Spray-dried camel milk: fresh camel milk is concentrated and dried in a spray chamber, as Al Ain Dairy in the UAE makes it under the Camelait brand. A trial in Ethiopia's Somali Region offered it to pastoralists, who rated it highly, though most preferred fresh milk.
